title: ChickenGuard Door Event Open Time Leaderboard
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chickenguard:door open_time=*
| stats sum(open_time) as total_value, avg(open_time) as avg_value by coop_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks coop values by total and average open time across ChickenGuard door event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `open_time` values for each ChickenGuard door event event and review total and average open time by coop.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total open time.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you which coop shows the biggest open time numbers in your ChickenGuard door event data.
